column1: # Covers: brands originating in or headquartered in Canada: banks, insurers and investment firms, telecom,
# retailers, grocers and pharmacies, restaurant and coffee chains, food, snacks, dairy, beer, whisky, wine,
# fashion, outerwear and footwear, cosmetics, pet food, tech, software and apps, game studios and games,
# media, newspapers, broadcasters, TV and animation, toys, airlines and transport, energy, mining,
# industrial and aerospace companies, cannabis brands, hotels, and NHL/NBA/MLB/MLS/CFL clubs.
# Hangul: Korean market names first (팀홀튼, 룰루레몬, 캐나다구스, 아크테릭스, 무스너클, 오리젠), then established
# Korean media spellings, else 외래어 표기법 (English; French for Québec brands).
# Sources: Wikipedia "List of companies of Canada", "List of Canadian restaurant chains", "List of Canadian
# brands", "List of breweries in Canada", "List of Canadian whisky brands", S&P/TSX 60 and TSX Composite
# constituents, Brand Finance Canada 100, league club lists; Korean news and 나무위키 for Hangul spellings.

# Note: compiled largely from the model's own knowledge; the lists named above describe the kinds of sources the entries follow and were not all consulted line by line. Hangul not checked line by line against Korean media.
